topic: Depositing your own money for a fake remote task job vs refusing (Leopold vs Annabelle)

scenes.narration: A remote job asked her to deposit her own money to get paid. Case file 0101. Time of incident, midweek.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named detective cash, sharp blue eyes, gray fedora hat, beige trench coat, five o'clock shadow, holding magnifying glass and a manila file folder labeled with dollar signs, detective cash in a noir office studying a chat app job offer and a deposit request, comic burst banner reads CASE FILE 0101, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Leopold and Annabelle both apply for flexible remote work.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man leopold and woman annabelle applying for remote jobs on laptops, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: A recruiter interviews them only through a chat app.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a faceless recruiter avatar conducting an interview inside a chat window, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The work is simple, click tasks and earn small commissions.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a task app screen with rows of tasks and tiny commission badges, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Small payouts arrive quickly, building complete trust.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a phone showing three small payouts landing, a trust meter filling, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Then a combination task requires depositing four hundred first.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a task screen reading DEPOSIT FOUR HUNDRED TO UNLOCK, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Leopold deposits, chases bigger tasks, and sends three thousand.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man leopold sending repeated deposits, a total tag reading THREE THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His account shows earnings he can never withdraw.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a dashboard showing huge earnings with a locked WITHDRAW button, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Annabelle refuses, knowing real jobs never need deposits.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman annabelle typing NO DEPOSITS and closing the chat, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She checks the company site and finds no such recruiter.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman annabelle comparing the recruiter name against an official staff page, stamped NOT FOUND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Leopold funded the scam. Annabelle kept her savings.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, an empty account and an untouched savings jar, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: A job that asks you to pay is never a job. Case closed.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named detective cash, sharp blue eyes, gray fedora hat, beige trench coat, five o'clock shadow, holding magnifying glass and a manila file folder labeled with dollar signs, detective cash in a noir office stamping a file CASE CLOSED, a board reads JOBS PAY YOU NOT THE REVERSE, kids comic book illustration
